standard_prerequisites.use: Applies to both cases after identification.

core_obligations: Existence of g_! on modules: lower-shriek-modules lemma (proof lines 2970-2971).
Lisse-etale case: identify X_lisse-etale/x with smooth schemes over U and X_etale/x with (Sch/U)_etale, apply the Etale Cohomology lemma to the comparison equation (proof lines 2978-2992).
Flat-fppf case: same with flat schemes (proof lines 2995-3009); g^*g_! = id from g^* = g^{-1} and the abelian-sheaf equality (proof lines 3012-3014).
proof_roadmap: Verify the comparison equation on both sites by explicit category identifications.
difficulty_reason: For each site the proof identifies the localized categories concretely (X_lisse-etale/x vs (Sch/U)_etale and its smooth subcategory; flat-fppf analogously) so that the Etale Cohomology compare-structure-sheaves lemma applies to the comparison equation, and the module-level g_! agrees with the abelian-sheaf one; g^*g_! = id follows from g^* = g^{-1} and the abelian equality.
